screen.quickcraft.title: QuickCraft Config
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.enabl:
§6Function: §rMaster toggle for jet-style crafting in the workbench screen.
§eAction: §rBind a hotkey in the general hotkey settings.
§eUse: §rSelect a recipe in the workbench recipe book, then press the hotkey.
§7Note: §rNo need to save recipes first like §bItemScroller§r.
§7Option: §rYou can choose whether to drop results when crafting stops.

§6Function: §rMaster toggle for jet-style crafting in the player 2x2 grid.
§eAction: §rBind a hotkey in the general hotkey settings.
§eUse: §rSelect a recipe in the backpack recipe book, then press the hotkey.
§7Note: §rNo need to save recipes first like §bItemScroller§r.
§7Option: §rYou can choose whether to drop results when crafting stops.

§6Function: §rMaster toggle for jet-style crafting in the stonecutter screen.
§eAction: §rBind a hotkey in the general hotkey settings.
§eUse: §rSelect a recipe in the stonecutter screen, then press the hotkey.
§7Note: §rNo need to save recipes first like §bItemScroller§r.
§7Option: §rYou can choose whether to drop results when crafting stops.

§6Function: §rSnapshots the new name from the left anvil input.
§eAction: §rRename one item, then press the crafting hotkey to batch rename matching unrenamed items.
§7Note: §rBind the crafting hotkey in the general hotkey settings first.
§cLimit: §rOnly batch renames; it does not batch enchant.
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.craft: §6Function: §rSets how many crafts rapid crafting can run per Tick.
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.showC:
§6Function: §rShows a small button at the lower-right of the workbench, 2x2 grid, and stonecutter output slot.
§eClick: §rSame as single craft.
§eRapid: §rHold §bAlt + Button§r to start rapid crafting.
§7Note: §rReleasing Alt or the button stops it.
quickcraft.config.crafting.comment.dropC: §6Function: §rWhen rapid crafting stops, immediately drops the current crafted result from the inventory.
quickcraft.config.container_tools.commen:
§6Function: §rEnables sliding quick transfer.
§eMatching Slide: §rHold the bound combo and slide over items to batch simulate Shift-transfer by touched item type.
§eSlot Slide: §rHold the bound combo and slide over slots; each touched slot runs one Shift-transfer.
§eNote: §rBoth bindings can be changed in the general hotkey settings.

§6Function: §rEnables retain-one quick transfer.
§eApplies To: §rWhen enabled, the hotkey below tries to leave 1 item in the source side for stackable items during click or slide transfer.
§eNote: §rOnly works between containers and the player inventory, and does not override vanilla Shift quick-move.

§6Function: §rKeeps vanilla Q and enables custom drop hotkeys.
§eDrop Stack: §rPress §bShift + Q§r.
§eDrop Matching: §rPress §bCtrl + Q§r.
§eNote: §rYou can change the bindings in the general hotkey settings.

§6Function: §rEnables quick trading.
§eNote: §rWhen enabled, §bright clicking§r a villager automatically performs the favorited trade.

§6Function: §rEnables §bmiddle click§r trade favoriting.
§eNote: §rThe favorited trade is moved to the first row.

§6Function: §rEnables sorting; press the sort hotkey to sort the hovered area.
§eNote: §rYou can change the binding in the general hotkey settings.
§7Rule: §rShulker boxes go last; enchanted diamond/netherite armor and weapons are prioritized.

§6Function: §rShows the full-lock button at the top-right of supported container and player inventory screens.
§eNote: §rDisabling this only hides the button and does not clear existing container lock states.

§6Function: §rShows small locks at the top-right of supported container and player inventory slots.
§eNote: §rCurrently this only displays and records slot lock state; it does not block QuickCraft automation.

§6Function: §rMaster switch for whether the current container tool mode is active.
§eNote: §rWhen disabled, Quick Stash, Container Copy, and Quick Clear will not respond.

§6Function: §rClick to cycle Quick Stash, Container Copy, and Quick Clear.
§eNote: §rThe current mode's right-click container action only works while the master switch is enabled.
§bQuick Clear: §rRight click a container to clear its contents.
§bQuick Stash: §rRight click a container to stash matching inventory items into it.
§bContainer Copy: §rMiddle click container 1 to record; right click matching container 2 to fill.

§6Function: §rRight click a beacon to activate it automatically.
§eNote: §rAutomatically supplies payment and can decompose matching mineral blocks.
§7Effect: §rActivates the next missing level II effect in the configured order.

§6Function: §rSets the level II effects to prioritize when auto activating beacons.
§eNote: §rFill entries 1 to 6 in order; English IDs and Chinese names are supported.
§bEnglish: §rhaste2, strength2, regeneration2
§bEnglish: §rjump_boost2, speed2, resistance2
§bChinese: §r急迫2、力量2、生命恢复2
§bChinese: §r跳跃提升2、迅捷2、抗性提升2
quickcraft.config.projection_tools.comme:
§6Function: §rShows a draggable 3D schematic preview on §bLitematica§r's load schematic screen.
§eNote: §rThe first selection of a .litematic file builds a preview cache; selecting the same file later loads that cache first.

§6Function: §rShows a container material list button on §bLitematica§r's load schematic screen.
§eNote: §rUses the vanilla material list screen to count saved container contents in the schematic.
quickcraft.litematica.preview_3d.too_lar: Schematic too large to preview safely
quickcraft.config.projection_tools.comme:
§6Function: §rShows slot error highlights and missing-item ghost hints when opening projection containers.
§eNote: §rOnly controls visual hints in container screens and does not affect verifier statistics.

§6Function: §rShows container fill verification categories in the §bLitematica§r verifier.
§eNote: §rChecks container slot contents and crafter locked-slot state.

§6Function: §rWhen a material list HUD is visible, right click a supported container to collect missing materials automatically.
§eNote: §rSupports the §bLitematica§r material list HUD.
§eSupport: §rAlso supports the §bQuickCraft§r container material list HUD.

§6Function: §rSets the extra amount to take when a single item is missing 10 or less.
§eNote: §rRange 0 to 10, default 0.

§6Function: §rSets the extra amount to take when a single item is missing 20 or less.
§eNote: §rRange 0 to 20, default 1.

§6Function: §rSets the extra amount to take when a single item is missing 50 or less.
§eNote: §rRange 0 to 50, default 3.

§6Function: §rSets the extra amount to take when a single item is missing 100 or less.
§eNote: §rRange 0 to 100, default 5.

§6Function: §rSets the extra amount to take when a single item is missing 500 or less.
§eNote: §rRange 0 to 500, default 10.

§6Function: §rSets the extra amount to take when a single item is missing over 500.
§eNote: §rRange 0 to 512, default 32.

§6Function: §rRight click the container matching a projection to fill the real container from the schematic.
§eNote: §rUses the saved items and slot contents for that container in the schematic.

§6Function: §rIn creative mode, container copy or projection autofill directly creates required items.
§eNote: §rDoes not consume inventory materials; fills the target container from the template.

§6Function: §rWhen cleaning extra items from container copy / projection fill, allows dropping them on the ground.
§eNote: §rFirst tries to return them to inventory; with Quick Shulker enabled, tries boxing them.
§7Limit: §rOnly drops full stacks when they still cannot fit.

§6Function: §rSets the maximum inventory slots to free before batch taking items with Quick Shulker.
§eNote: §rRange 0 to 36, default 5.
§7Tip: §r0 means free as many slots as possible except protected items.

§6Function: §rSets items to protect while freeing inventory slots before filling.
§eNote: §rThese items will not be temporarily moved into Quick Shulker boxes.
§bFormat: §rSupports Chinese names, full IDs, or short IDs.
§bExample: §rGolden Carrot, minecraft:golden_carrot
§bExample: §rgolden_carrot
§7Always Protected: §rShulker boxes, first firework stack, enchanted diamond/netherite tools and armor.

§6Function: §rReplaces filler items when auto filling projection containers or collecting container materials.
§eNote: §rEnter one §bItem 1 -> Item 2§r rule per line.
§eFormat: §rChinese is recommended; full IDs and short IDs are also supported.
§bExample: §rRedstone -> Shears
§bExample: §rminecraft:redstone -> minecraft:shears
§7Note: §rVerification, highlights, and material HUDs are unaffected.
quickcraft.config.mod_support.comment.en:
§6Function: §rEnables §bQuick Shulker§r support for shulker box assistance.
§eRequirement: §rOnly works when both client and server support it.
§eUse: §rUsed for auto collecting projection materials.
§eUse: §rAlso used for background box opening during container copy / projection autofill.
quickcraft.config.mod_support.comment.qu:
§6Function: §rSets the action interval for Quick Shulker background opening and item transfer.
§eNote: §rRange 0 to 20 Tick, default 5; 0 means unlimited speed.
§7Tip: §rHigher values are slower and better for servers sensitive to packets.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.enable:
§6Function: §rAllows opening the §bQuickCraft§r config screen with a hotkey.
§eNote: §rWhen disabled, the config screen can only be opened from §bMod Menu§r.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.openCo:
§6Function: §rHotkey for opening the §bQuickCraft§r config screen.
§eNote: §rOnly responds while the player has no other screen open.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.single:
§6Function: §rRuns one quick craft action in supported crafting screens.
§eNote: §rPressing once triggers one craft.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.rapidC:
§6Function: §rKeeps rapid crafting running in supported crafting screens.
§eNote: §rHold to keep it active; release to stop.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.quickS:
§6Function: §rSorts the current container area, or the player inventory when no screen is open.
§eNote: §rThe target depends on the hovered area.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.dropMa:
§6Function: §rDrops all visible items matching the hovered item within the current area.
§eNote: §rHover the target item first, then press the hotkey.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.dropWh:
§6Function: §rDrops the entire stack in the hovered slot.
§eNote: §rHover the target slot first, then press the hotkey.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.quickT:
§6Function: §rBatch simulates matching Shift-transfer.
§eNote: §rHold the combo and slide over items; it affects the touched item types.

§6Function: §rTransfers matching items in bulk while trying to leave 1 item in the source side.
§eNote: §rHold the combo and click or slide over items; inventory -> container keeps 1 in the inventory, container -> inventory keeps 1 in the container.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.slotQu:
§6Function: §rSimulates Shift-transfer by slot.
§eNote: §rHold the combo and slide over slots; each touched slot is handled once.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.slotLo:
§6Function: §rToggles the lock icon display on the hovered slot.
§eNote: §rDefault §bAlt + Right Click§r.
§7Limit: §rCurrently only changes display state and does not block §bQuickCraft§r automation.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.copyCo:
§6Function: §rRecords the contents of a supported container as a template.
§eNote: §rPress while aiming at a supported container to record; aim at air to clear the cache.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.contin:
§6Function: §rHold to continuously fill the target container under the crosshair.
§eNote: §rFills from a copied container template or projection container contents.
§7Tip: §rWith Quick Shulker support, it opens boxes in the background to take exact items.
quickcraft.config.hotkeys.comment.toggle:
§6Function: §rSwitches the current container assistant tool mode.
§eNote: §rPress once to cycle Quick Stash, Container Copy, and Quick Clear.
